value.rationale: All three fundamental characters of SU(4) form a canonical central Fourier packet. Fourth moments on this packet encode two independent nonabelian representation fusion collisions. The sharp 51/11 ratio substantially exceeds the pure-character ratios 2,2,3 and gives a full equality classification plus an explicit nonnegative stability decomposition that explains all phase and magnitude constraints. This is an exact natural invariant for a rank-three compact simple group, not an arbitrary thin parameter slice or a known-table numerical recomputation.
